purpose: Freeze an obvious rare DiT-XL/2 ImageNet-256 failure before any cross-scale path evidence is implemented for DiT.

baseline.configuration: DiT-XL/2, ImageNet-256, 250-step ancestral DDPM, CFG 4.0, MSE VAE

selection_constraints.required_interpretation: discovery target only; a larger blinded same-class reference set and two-reviewer v3 adjudication are still required

candidate.reason: The golden retriever has an impossible duplicated/fused torso: a tail-like appendage exits near the shoulder while the hindquarters and limb topology do not form a coherent single dog. The defect is conspicuous at native 256 resolution and is plainly below the other nine class-207 samples in this scan.

analysis_rule: Do not call the 1/80 scan rate an artifact-rate estimate. Use this image only as a frozen engineering target when DiT path evidence and intervention are implemented.
